eyebrow.zh: 数据旅程 · 五年增长轨迹

title.zh: 从试点到规模化：清洁能源装机增长
title.en: From Pilot to Scale: Clean-Energy Capacity Growth

subtitle.zh: 镜头沿时间线逐段推进，让每一个里程碑拥有独立的阅读停顿。
subtitle.en: The camera advances along the timeline, giving every milestone a dedicated reading pause.

note.zh: 首批示范项目完成并网，验证区域协同能力。
note.en: The first demonstration projects connect to the grid and validate regional coordination.

note.zh: 建设范围扩展到重点工业区域，增量开始加速。
note.en: Deployment expands into major industrial regions and annual additions begin to accelerate.

note.zh: 储能与调度系统接入，消纳效率进一步提升。
note.en: Storage and dispatch systems come online, improving utilization efficiency.

note.zh: 标准化建设降低交付成本，装机进入规模增长阶段。
note.en: Standardized delivery lowers cost and moves capacity into a scaled-growth phase.

note.zh: 年度新增装机达到新高，五年规模超过最初的四倍。
note.en: Annual additions reach a new record and total scale exceeds four times the starting level.

finalTakeaway.zh: 增长并非一次跳跃，而是由试点、整合与规模化连续推动。
finalTakeaway.en: Growth is not a single leap; it is a sequence of pilots, integration, and scaling.

source.zh: DataMagic Cards 合成演示数据
